name: meridian
description: Meridian v1 — a static file:// app. The app itself has zero dependencies; this file only carries test scripts. Playwright lives in tests/e2e and is installed there.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.e2e:setup: npm --prefix tests/e2e install && npm --prefix tests/e2e exec -- playwright install chromium
